scope: Contributor development diagnostic only, no original first-use or owner admission
protocol: Same frozen HiddenWorld, A96 shared public rows; B64/R64 independent active policy vs externally forced action replay; one fully exited child process per phase per world. All 13 interventions equal cost. At each phase endpoint 32 held contexts for both chosen and common-action predictions, never observe held labels. Same public exposure available to all; core arms deliberately do not consume mediators. Distinct active exposures not equal information.
metrics: Phase chosen held reward, forced-action held Brier, observed regret using evaluator-only counterfactuals, prequential Brier; frozen A functional source readout after B/R cold restore, full held checkpoint immutability, per-mode forced exposure SHA256 equality. CPU time for model choose/predict/update/pack/unpack/source reads excludes evaluator world computation and serialized interprocess transfer; include reconstruct/sort in measured inference. Per-call shared metered rule cap and checkpoint cap; transient full-process memory not matched. No claims of complete Bayes exactness or independently strongest control.
decision: All thresholds must pass to retain candidate for independent design, never SCIENTIFIC_PASS on six development worlds. On any threshold failure preserve diagnostic NO-GO. No parameter sweeps, seed replacement, primary 501000-503023 access, native integration, changes to accepted main or owner runner. Fully trained strongest control adequacy and independent scientific reproduction remain unverified.
